ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the producer in the diagram shown?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a marine food web, with the text label “sea ice phytoplankton” at the top, and an arrow from that label pointing to the krill below. The diagram also shows food relationship arrows between krill and consumers such as penguins, seals, fish, whales, etc. Reasoning: In a food web, producers are usually located at the starting point of the energy source, can make their own food, and provide energy for other organisms. In the diagram, the one located at the starting point of the food web and pointed from by arrows toward consumers is “sea ice phytoplankton”. Therefore, the producer is sea ice phytoplankton.
